description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
Nice — sounds like a lovely, restful weekend with Maria. Would you like help turning that into an email (to share photos or tell friends/family), a thank-you note to your sister, or a short social update?

Here are three quick email templates you can use. Tell me which one you want and who to send it to (and whether to attach photos), and I’ll draft or send it for you.

1) Casual note to friends/family
Subject: Quick update — weekend in the countryside
Body:
Hi [Name],
Just wanted to share a quick update — Maria and I spent the weekend in the countryside exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air. It was so relaxing and exactly what we needed. I’ve attached a few photos.
Hope you’re doing well — let’s catch up soon!
Best,  
[Your name]

2) Thank-you note to your sister
Subject: Thanks for a great weekend
Body:
Hi Maria,
Thanks for such a lovely weekend. I really enjoyed the trails and the chance to unwind together — it was perfect. Let’s plan another trip soon.
Love,  
[Your name]

3) Short social-style update (for wider group)
Subject: Weekend recharge
Body:
Hi everyone,
Spent the weekend in the countryside with my sister Maria — lots of nature walks, fresh air, and relaxation. Feeling recharged! Sharing a couple photos below.
— [Your name]

What would you like me to do with one of these? (Draft it, send it now, or edit the text.) If sending, please tell me the recipient(s) and any photos or attachments to include.
